provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Athletics: sprinting
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state the meaning of sprinting.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate safe sprinting.

Introduction:
We have learned about running in class.
Today we will learn about running fast.

Content:
Sprinting is running fast for a short time.
We sprint on the field or playground.
We must look where we run to avoid falling.
We use our arms to help us run faster.
Example: Like a danfo bus in traffic.

Class activity:
Line up and sprint to a cone.
Count 1 2 3 then run fast.

Evaluation questions:
What is sprinting?
How many feet do we use to sprint?
Why must we look ahead when sprinting?

Summary:
Sprinting is running fast for a short time.

topics.title: Long jump basics
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to demonstrate a long jump.
The pupils should be able to identify the landing position.

Introduction:
We have learned about jumping before.
Today we will learn to jump far.

Content:
Long jump is jumping from a line far away.
We stand behind a line on the ground.
We bend our knees and swing our arms.
We jump forward and land on two feet.
Example: Like a harmattan wind blowing far.

Class activity:
Draw a line on the sand.
Each pupil jumps from the line.

Evaluation questions:
How many feet do we land on?
What do we do before jumping?
Why do we bend our knees?

Summary:
Long jump is jumping far and landing on two feet.

topics.title: Ball games: kicking
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to kick a ball with control.
The pupils should be able to name one ball game.

Introduction:
We have played with balls before.
Today we will learn to kick balls.

Content:
Kicking is using our foot to hit a ball.
We kick footballs and other balls.
We place the ball on the ground.
We kick it with the side of our foot.
Example: Like market traders kicking goods.

Class activity:
Place balls in a line.
Pupils take turns kicking to a goal.

Evaluation questions:
What part of the foot do we use?
What ball games do you know?
How do we place the ball before kicking?

Summary:
Kicking is hitting a ball with our foot.

topics.title: Safety in games
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list two game rules.
The pupils should be able to explain why rules are important.

Introduction:
We have played many games in class.
Today we will learn to play safely.

Content:
Rules are instructions for games.
Rules keep us from getting hurt.
We must follow all game rules.
We should not push or grab others.
Example: Like traffic rules for danfo buses.

Class activity:
Play a simple game with rules.
Stop if rules are broken.

Evaluation questions:
Why do we need rules?
What happens if we break rules?
Name one rule for games.

Summary:
Rules keep us safe when we play.

topics.title: Posture: standing and sitting
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to demonstrate good standing posture.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate good sitting posture.

Introduction:
We stand and sit every day.
Today we will learn to do it well.

Content:
Good posture is standing and sitting correctly.
When standing we keep our back straight.
We do not slouch or bend our backs.
When sitting we keep our feet flat.
Example: Like a tall palm tree.

Class activity:
Practice standing tall and sitting well.
Use a wall to check straight backs.

Evaluation questions:
How should we stand?
How should we sit?
Why is good posture important?

Summary:
Good posture helps us stay healthy.

topics.title: Teeth care
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state when to brush teeth.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate proper brushing.

Introduction:
We use our teeth to eat every day.
Today we will learn to care for them.

Content:
Teeth care means keeping teeth clean.
We brush our teeth twice daily.
We use a soft brush and toothpaste.
We brush in circles, not back and forth.
Example: Like cleaning yam with a brush.

Class activity:
Practice brushing with a model.
Count 10 brushes for each tooth area.

Evaluation questions:
When should we brush our teeth?
What do we use to brush teeth?
How do we brush our teeth?

Summary:
We brush our teeth twice daily to keep them clean.

topics.title: First aid: simple cuts
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to tell an adult about a cut.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate washing a cut.

Introduction:
Sometimes we get small cuts on our skin.
Today we will learn what to do.

Content:
First aid is help for small injuries.
For cuts we tell an adult first.
We wash the cut with clean water.
We cover it with a clean cloth or bandage.
Example: Like a market wound from knife.

Class activity:
Show how to wash a cut with water.
Practice covering with a clean cloth.

Evaluation questions:
What is first aid?
What do we do first for a cut?
Why do we cover a cut?

Summary:
For cuts, tell an adult, wash and cover.

topics.title: Clean water and exercise
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify clean water.
The pupils should be able to name one exercise.

Introduction:
Water is important for our bodies.
Exercise helps us stay strong.

Content:
Clean water is safe to drink.
We get clean water from boreholes or treated sources.\ Dirty water can make us sick.
Exercise is moving our bodies.
We exercise by running, jumping or playing.
Example: Like fetching water from a well.

Class activity:
Pupits jump and run for exercise.
Drink water after exercise.

Evaluation questions:
What is clean water?
Why do we need clean water?
Name one way to exercise.

Summary:
Clean water and exercise keep us healthy.

topics.title: Simple gymnastics
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to perform a simple stretch.
The pupils should be able to perform a simple bend.

Introduction:
We have moved our bodies in many ways.
Today we will learn gymnastic moves.

Content:
Gymnastics is moving our bodies in special ways.
We stretch our arms and legs.
We bend forward and sideways.
We must be careful not to fall.
Example: Like a plant bending in wind.

Class activity:
Practice stretching arms up high.
Bend to touch toes carefully.

Evaluation questions:
What is gymnastics?
How do we stretch our arms?
Why must we be careful in gymnastics?

Summary:
Gymnastics is safe moving of our bodies.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall three skills learned.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate one skill.

Introduction:
We have learned many things this term.
Today we will show what we know.

Content:
We will review sprinting and jumping.
We will review kicking and safety rules.
We will review posture and teeth care.
Each pupil will show one skill.
Example: Like a market display of goods.

Class activity:
Pupils take turns showing skills.
Others clap for good work.

Evaluation questions:
What did you learn about sprinting?
Show how to sit with good posture.
Why is it important to drink clean water?

Summary:
We have learned many skills this term.
